cases.claim: Stopping a registered callback before cancellation returns true on the first stop and false on a second stop.
A false stop result proves that the callback is currently running.
Stopping an already started callback waits until that callback finishes.
Two AfterFunc registrations on the same context operate independently rather than replacing each other.
Registration on an already canceled context still schedules the callback in its own goroutine.
After registration, reassigning only the caller local context variable redirects the registration to the new context.
The application is required to report callback latency above ten milliseconds as an incident.
